description: This file defines the PhotosListActivity class, which extends ListActivity and is responsible for displaying a list of photos fetched from a Picasa feed URL, using a custom cursor adapter that parses XML data.

classes.name: PhotosListActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a list of photos fetched from a Picasa web feed, utilizing custom XML parsing via a cursor adapter.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds the list adapter to display photos from the specified feed URL.
